subject: CloudForge vendor portal access & evidence delivery plan
messages:
From: Emily Rios <emily.rios@cloudforge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, security@cloudforge.com
Cc: procure@cloudforge.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: CloudForge: initial portal access for evidence & SIG questionnaire

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this — I'm Emily on CloudForge's security team. We need to get Redwood set up on our vendor portals so we can complete the SIG/CAIQ and collect your SOC 2 evidence.

Plan I propose:
- We'll send an OneTrust invite for the Q&A and a Vendr entry for S3 proofs.
- We'll upload a current SIG export and a short SOC 2 cover note to the portal.
- For any large artifacts (SOC report, syslog excerpts) we can share an S3 manifest with restricted links.

Attached: CloudForge_SIG_2026_v2.pdf (partial, redacted) — we'll finalize once we confirm the OneTrust scope.

Can you confirm: preferred point of contact for evidence uploads (name + email), and any SLA on when a first pass is expected? We have a renewal window mid-December so a week turnaround would be ideal.

Best,
Emily
Emily Rios
Senior Security Analyst, CloudForge
attachments: CloudForge_SIG_2026_v2.pdf (pdf, 820KB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:00:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: CloudForge: initial portal access for evidence & SIG questionnaire

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and for the attached SIG export.

Kimberly (security intake) and Marcus (platform ops) are looped in. Short answers up front:
- Point of contact for uploads: kimberly.park@redwood.com (primary), marcus.lin@redwood.com (infrastructure / KMS artifacts)
- Target turnaround: we can do a first pass in 5 business days for the CAIQ/SIG canned answers and SOC2 cover note; longer for long-tail artifacts (syslogs, full SOC2).

A couple asks to make onboarding smooth:
1) Please invite kimberly.park@redwood.com to OneTrust with contributor access rather than view-only, so we can attach evidentiary files.
2) If you have a CAIQ subset you want prioritized, list the top 20 controls — we'll triage those first.
3) Confirm the preferred evidence delivery method for SOC2 (portal upload vs signed S3 link).

We can set up a 30-min touchpoint if that's helpful — propose Thu 26th 10:00 CET.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rios <emily.rios@cloudforge.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:10:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: CloudForge: initial portal access for evidence & SIG questionnaire

Emily / Sofia — thanks, Emily. A few operational items from intake: 

Priority deliverables we need on the vendor portal for the first pass (minimal acceptable set):
- Completed SIG questionnaire export (prefer JSON/CSV) or CAIQ PDF subset for top 20 controls
- SOC 2: cover letter + auditor's logo page (redacted if needed) — if only a full report is available we accept signed S3 links
- Evidence manifest: short CSV listing artifacts, owners, expiry / TTL and access path (I attached a template).

Upload permissions: contributor on OneTrust is ideal. For Vendr/S3 entries, please mark objects with time-limited presign and include the manifest URL.

I attached evidence_manifest_template.xlsx — fill the first tab and we'll use that to coordinate.

If the team prefers to hand off large logs to Marcus, cc him on the S3 ACL notes.

Attachment: evidence_manifest_template.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
